hostView.page: 存档中心 / 历史版本

observations: Before scroll, the first visible history row and selected inspector version were both 13:05.
A desktop-injected scroll in the history list moved its first visible row to 12:40 while the inspector remained on 13:05.
A desktop-injected scroll in the inspector kept the history list at 12:40 and exposed the bottom restorability-validation button.
limits: Only the dark theme at the normal host size was observed; light theme and narrow/short window states remain unverified.
The installed DLL identity is recorded, but Process.Modules did not expose the loaded extension assembly path for this process.
Injected scroll is real host interaction through automation, not a physical mouse-wheel test or physical DPI audit.
